summary: This Phase 2/3 clinical trial is testing a drug called tirzepatide to help adults with type 1 diabetes manage their blood sugar. The study is currently Recruiting and aims to include 105 participants. McGill University Health Centre/Research Institute of the McGill University Health Centre is sponsoring the research. The trial compares using tirzepatide with an automated insulin delivery system against standard care.
